meta.title: Linear – Designed for the development cycle
meta.description: Linear is a purpose-built tool for modern software development. Streamline issues, projects, and product roadmaps.

findings.title: All Major AI Search Crawlers Allowed
findings.description: GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended are permitted to crawl your content.
findings.evidence: No disallow rules found for major AI user-agents in robots.txt.

findings.title: Standard /llms.txt File Present
findings.description: Linear serves an /llms.txt file to aid AI parser extraction.

findings.title: Stat Density Slightly Below Princeton Benchmark
findings.description: The Princeton GEO study proves that adding specific numerical statistics boosts LLM citation rates by up to 40%. Linear's homepage currently sits at 2.4 stats per 500 words (benchmark: 3.0+).
findings.evidence: Found 12 numerical facts across 2,500 words (2.4 stats per 500 words).
findings.fixNeeded: Add explicit metrics regarding issue resolution speed and customer team sizes to the top hero section.

findings.title: Missing SoftwareApplication JSON-LD Schema
findings.description: Linear has an Organization schema but is missing explicit SoftwareApplication JSON-LD markup detailing its operating systems, features, and pricing tier.
findings.fixNeeded: Embed a SoftwareApplication schema block in the website header.

metrics.reasoning: Linear is consistently cited as the benchmark issue tracker for modern tech startups.

findings.title: Strong Live AI Engine Visibility
findings.description: Linear ranks in the Top 3 for queries like 'best issue tracker for startups'.

# Linear
> Linear is a purpose-built tool for modern software development. Streamline issues, projects, and product roadmaps.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- Issue tracking with keyboard-first UI
- Automated project cycles and roadmaps
- Native GitHub and Figma integrations

## Official Resources
- Website: https://linear.app
- Documentation: https://linear.app/docs

What is Linear?

Linear is an issue tracking and project management system optimized for speed and modern software development teams with sub-50ms sync speed.
